name: Lab: 5 deg grid (56 points), eye tracker, 60 cm
description: For testing (15 Nov). BenQ 24.5" (542.3 x 305 mm), chin rest so the eye is 60 cm from the screen (the Tobii Pro Fusion does not track properly at 50-52 cm; the grid fits up to 62 cm). Our 5 deg grid: 56 points, 5 deg apart everywhere, + in the centre. Full Threshold 4-2 staircase (OPI). Gentler fixation check (our suggestion, to tune): 3 deg window, short flicks and tracker gaps up to 150 ms ignored, a patch thrown away only if over a quarter of its gaze is off the +, blinks never count as looking away: a patch not seen during a blink (eye lost 100 ms or more) is repeated, and after a blink the next patch waits 300 ms more. Start python\specvis.bat tracker-bridge first. Choose the ColorCAL scale "Lab screen".
